description: eugr's (Eugene Rakhmatulin) spark-vllm-docker recipes qwen3.8-flash-next-nvfp4-solo and -cluster for local-inference-lab's Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-NVFP4 (quantization-aware-distilled ModelOpt export, NVFP4 experts with MXFP8 attention; Qwen Community licence, informational; checkpoint revision 6c01ac37, about 106 GB of weights) served by vLLM on a single Spark. Runs eugr's published vllm-node-b12x image (--exp-b12x lane, nightly-20260929, digest pinned; its build-metadata records spark-vllm-docker 42f62e34, vLLM local-inference-lab/vllm dev/karmic-kraken 0296a817, FlashInfer 4a638133 and b12x master) with upstream's launch: the b12x kernel stack (b12x model loader, linear, MoE and gated-delta-net decode kernels, modelopt_mixed quantization, bfloat16 dtype, FP8 KV cache, block size 16, mamba cache mode align), MTP with four speculative tokens, chunked prefill, prefix caching, qwen3 reasoning and qwen3_xml tool parsing, multimodal encoder tensor-parallel mode data, FlashInfer autotune off, act-quant fusion compilation pass, 262,144-token context and 4,096 batched tokens (upstream defaults), plus upstream's environment for the b12x stack. This is upstream's solo recipe (solo-only): upstream sets VLLM_PLE_TABLE_MEMORY=disk, but this image's disk table supports only io_uring (blocked by the sandbox seccomp profile) and direct GDS (no real nvidia-fs), so the PLE table is held in host-shared RAM instead (VLLM_PLE_TABLE_MEMORY=shared; hardware failure 2026-11-01 cuFile error 5027), eight sequences and memory utilisation 0.905. Deviation from upstream (0.8), forced by moving the PLE table (about 28.8 GB) into the vLLM budget: at 0.8 the budget cannot hold the weights plus the table, so 0.905 (the single-Spark admission maximum) is used, estimated from the weights, the table, the margin the platform holds beside the budget and one full-context request; it is an estimate with no hardware evidence yet, replaced by the first measured run. Upstream's disk offload left the budget to KV cache (its changelog claims more than 1M tokens of KV cache); with the table in shared RAM the KV pool is smaller, so fewer concurrent long contexts fit than upstream. No upstream performance claims are recorded. Upstream repository MIT. Physical Spark acceptance is pending. GB10 memory: peak = 0.905 × 130,663,231,488 + 6.2e9 single-Spark vLLM margin held beside the budget (2 GiB host floor); an estimate, not a measured footprint, replaced by the first measured run.
title: Qwen3.8 Flash Next NVFP4 b12x vLLM single Spark (eugr)
